## ERITREA — profile (page 156)

- **Header facts:** Sub-Saharan Africa; Low-income; IDA; Estimated data (E); Population 3.6 million; **Unit:** US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** **720.5**, **+3.3% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Printed start and end values are **875.5** (2015) and **720.5** (2025). The line trends downward overall from 2015 to 2025, with the **peak in 2015 (875.5)**. It falls sharply in 2016, ticks up slightly in 2017, then declines with small fluctuations through ≈2019–21, drops to a lower level in ≈2022–23, dips further in ≈2024, and edges up slightly in 2025 to **720.5**.
